title: Joint density: how much grain does rock have?
question: Which density reads as broken rock rather than as a pattern?
context_md:
Same charge, same world, same everything - only how far apart the rock's joints are. Both panes show the blast at 6 frames and again at 240 frames.

This is the knob your *"I like a little of it, but there is too much"* points at, and I would rather you set it than have me guess from a cave sheet on another branch. One of these is what I shipped; the other is clearly coarser. Coarser gives you two or three big blocks and stops reading as a web; finer gives more, smaller pieces.

There is no wrong answer here and no cost either way - it is one number, and blocks scale with it, so tell me if you want it coarser still than both of these.
